Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026. IronEdge ("we", "us") operates ironedgeconsultant.com. This page explains what information we collect through this site and how it's used.

What we collect

When you submit the contact form or the quote popup, we collect what you type in: name, email, phone number, business name, service interest, budget range, and project details. We don't collect anything else automatically — this site does not use analytics or advertising cookies.

How we use it

Solely to respond to your inquiry, discuss your project, and send you a quote. We don't sell, rent, or share your information with any third party for marketing purposes.

Third-party processing

Form submissions are delivered to us using Formspree, a third-party form-processing service. Formspree receives the data you submit in order to email it to us. See Formspree's privacy policy for how they handle it.

Local storage

We use your browser's temporary session storage to remember that you've already seen the exit-intent popup, so it doesn't reappear. This is cleared automatically when you close the tab and isn't a tracking cookie.

Your rights

You can ask us to delete any information you've submitted at any time by emailing ironedge121@gmail.com.

Changes

We may update this policy occasionally. Check back here for the current version.

This is a general-purpose policy, not legal advice. If your business handles sensitive personal data, payments, or EU/UK customers, have a lawyer review this before relying on it.

Terms of Use

Last updated: August 2026. By using ironedgeconsultant.com, you agree to the following.

Site content

This website is provided for general information about IronEdge's web design and development services. Content, pricing ranges, and portfolio examples are illustrative and subject to change without notice.

Portfolio / example work

Designs shown in the "Our Work" section are concept demonstrations created to showcase design style and range, not screenshots of live client websites, unless stated otherwise.

Quotes & project scope

Budget ranges and quotes discussed through this site or the contact form are estimates only. Nothing here forms a binding contract — actual project scope, price, and timeline are agreed separately in writing before work begins.

No guaranteed results

We build websites intended to help your business look professional and convert visitors, but we don't guarantee specific business outcomes, traffic, sales, or search rankings.

Liability

IronEdge is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of this website, to the extent permitted by law.

Intellectual property

Site design and written content on ironedgeconsultant.com are the property of IronEdge unless otherwise credited.

Contact

Questions about these terms: ironedge121@gmail.com.

How It Works

Four Steps. Zero Hassle.

Simple process, fast delivery. You focus on your business while we handle everything.

STEP 01

You Email Us Everything

Send us your business info, goals, branding, content, and inspiration. The more detail, the better the result.

STEP 02

We Design It

We build to your vision with our professional edge applied — making it look and feel like it cost a lot more than it did.

STEP 03

30-Minute Review Call

We book a quick call to walk through the site together, answer any questions, and make your final tweaks.

STEP 04

We Hand It Over

Once you're happy it's yours — delivered clean and complete. No strings, no ongoing fees, no subscriptions.

About IronEdge

A 16-Year-Old Building Websites That Compete.

My name is Amrit and I started IronEdge at 16 because I realized most small businesses are paying thousands to agencies for websites that are slow, generic, and forgettable. I build better ones — faster, at a better price, and with more care than any agency junior ever would.

I'm not doing this for pocket money. I'm building a real business, and that means every client I take on gets my full attention. You'll never be handed off to someone else. You talk directly to me, I build your site, and I make sure you're genuinely happy with it before you pay a penny more.

I'm hungry to prove myself — and that's exactly why your website will be better than anything a $5,000 agency would send you.

Available Worldwide No Monthly Fees Direct Communication
What sets IronEdge apart
You Work With Me, Not a Team
No account managers, no handoffs, no miscommunication. One person builds your site start to finish.
Premium Quality, Honest Pricing
You get agency-level quality at a fraction of the cost. Fixed quotes, no surprises.
Fast Turnaround
Most projects are complete within 1–2 weeks. No waiting months for a website.
Built to Convert, Not Just Look Good
Every decision is made with one goal: get you more leads, more sales, more business.
Why IronEdge

Built Different. Delivered Better.

We're not a big agency with layers of management. You get better results because you work directly with the person who cares most about your outcome.

Speed-First Builds

Every site is built fast-loading. Fast sites rank higher on Google and keep visitors from bouncing before they've even read a word.
